title: SMOK Nord 2 Replacement Pods
description: The bestselling Smok Nord 2 pod kit is one of the most versatile refillable pod kits around, packing a host of features into a sleek, compact design that’s simple to use and offers unbeatable flavour. Nord pods - These replacement 2ml pods are compatible with all of Smok’s Nord coils , allowing for near-limitless options to tailor your vape to your exact preferences. Easy to refill and mess-free, simply top up your e-liquid through the silicon sealed port. The ultra-wide ‘duck-bill’ mouthpiece provides a wonderfully warm and comfortable vape. Please Note: Coils are not included and must be purchased separately - Smok Nord Coils RPM pods - These replacement 2ml pods are compatible with all of Smok’s RPM coils, allowing for near-limitless options to tailor your vape to your exact preferences. The ultra-wide ‘duck-bill’ mouthpiece provides a wonderfully warm and comfortable vape. Easy to refill and mess-free, simply top up your e-liquid through the silicon sealed port. Please Note: Coils are not included and must be purchased separately - Smok RPM Coils Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
